name: Bormujos (Spain)
description: Dark green field with a yellow cross fimbriated white set towards the hoist, charged at the crossing with the crowned municipal arms of Bormujos (a tree and a shovel on green).
history: Municipal flag of Bormujos; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
